package.title: Package delivery
package.intro: The box is due before lunch. Keep a clear spot in the morning.
package.success: The box arrived without bumping the morning.
package.failure: The courier had to wait at the door.
package.outcome: The new decoration found a place.

repair.title: Repair visit
repair.intro: The repair van is outside. The shower is closed until half past nine.
repair.failure: The blocked shower held up the morning.
repair.outcome: The repair van left before lunch.

favoriteShow.title: Favorite show
favoriteShow.intro: The new episode starts at seven. Dinner needs another spot.
favoriteShow.success: Dinner moved. The couch is free for seven.
favoriteShow.failure: Dinner ran through the opening scene.
favoriteShow.outcome: Watched the credits from the couch.

headache.title: Headache day
headache.intro: A headache slows every workout. A nap clears it.
headache.failure: The headache stayed through the workout.
headache.outcome: Closed the curtains and slept it off.

sleptGreat.title: Slept great
sleptGreat.intro: Wide awake half an hour early. The morning is open.
sleptGreat.success: The early half-hour went to Practice.
sleptGreat.outcome: Played guitar before the kettle clicked.

burnedBreakfast.title: Burned breakfast
burnedBreakfast.intro: Breakfast burned. It barely fills the gap.
burnedBreakfast.success: A snack covered the burned breakfast.
burnedBreakfast.outcome: Burned the toast. Ate it anyway.

emptyFridge.title: Empty fridge
emptyFridge.intro: Meals are out until the delivery arrives at two. Snacks still work.
emptyFridge.failure: The empty fridge caught up before delivery.
emptyFridge.outcome: The grocery bags arrived after lunch.

roughNight.title: Rough night
roughNight.intro: Morning starts tired. A well-placed nap can steady the day.
roughNight.success: The nap put some spring back.
roughNight.failure: The short night dragged into evening.
roughNight.outcome: Made it through on a quiet afternoon nap.
